title: Silas and the Cipher
author: Emrys Pemberton
blurb: Cyrus Oyelaran, the archivist of a cathedral with a locked crypt, has spent ten years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. Then the missing person's diary continues past the date she disappeared — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must find the witness everyone swears is dead before the statute expires.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
